blocks.text: Explore Guwahati to Cherrapunji Journey with Kajaawa Cabs

content.text: Journey from Guwahati to Cherrapunji will take you around four and a half hours to travel while indulging in the scenic beauty of the place. Enjoy your journey filled with fresh mist from the waterfalls, rolling meadows, and much more. On this journey, you might also come across locals and their lifestyle and way of living, some may be seen farming or in tea plantations. They always have a wide smile on their face and greet all tourists with warmth and love. To make our trip memorable, the roads are safe and well-maintained to help you have a smooth trip.

Nohkalikai Falls located in Cherrapunji is the world’s fourth-tallest waterfall plunge. Tourists from all over come to visit nature’s finest splendor and the story behind its name. Nohkalikai, in the local language, means ‘the leap of Likai. Ka Likai was a young mother who resided beside this waterfall, she was widowed at a young age but got remarried. Her husband disliked the attention Ka Likai gave a daughter. One day when she was out, her husband killed the daughter and cooked her flesh. When ka likai returned she was served her daughter’s flesh, on learning the truth she was devastated and threw herself to death from the waterfall. This is how it received its name.

At a distance of 17 km from Cherrapunji, Kynrem Waterfalls is a stunning fall located near Cherrapunji in the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya. Situated inside the Thangkharang Park, it is the 7th highest waterfall in India and among the popular places to visit in Cherrapunji. Falling from a height of about 305 m (1,001 feet), Kynrem Falls is one of the highest waterfalls in Meghalaya that cascades in three levels from the top of a hill.

Dainthlen Falls, one of the most gorgeous falls you will ever see. There is a small story attached with the name of this fall. It is said that a huge python named Thlen was caught by local brave men and destroyed its hood with a stone from the fall and removed itself from the reign of terror. There still remains to crave of the snake on the stones that tourists come to witness located opposite to the waterfall. The powerful sight of the waterfall, and the waterfall cascading through the rocks is a breathtaking view. Travelers flock to the site because of this past incident, to visually see the story craving on the rocks and the thundering sound of the waterfall.

Mawsmai Cave is a popular limestone and historical cave in Cherrapunji. Every year a huge number of tourists visit this natural cave. This is the only limestone cave in Meghalaya that has enough natural light for visitors to witness the natural formations. This cave is quite long and deep. However visitors can only proceed to 150 m inside the cave and the rest is off-limits for tourists.

Located near Mawsmai Falls, this intricate structure of stones holds ancient historical values. It is said that these monoliths are scattered on the plains representing the memories of the ancestors and underground mazes and caves that are waiting to be explored

Thangkharang Park is a great park at Cherrapunjee. It is located near the Khoh Ramhah rock, only a tad edge of the Cherrapunjee town. There are very much kept up with gardens, appealing wellspring, open play regions with rides for kids’ delight, and a nursery with different types of plants and trees in the recreation center. It has a great deal of plant life with numerous tall trees and blooming plants, huge butterflies rippling around, two or three appealing greenhouses worth seeing, and a perspective of Bangladesh fields beneath from the nursery’s edge.

The state government of Meghalaya has created a park on the plateaus to give tourists a grasping view of Shillong Agri- Horticulture with beautiful greenhouses and orchids. From this viewpoint, the exotic Sylhet Plains of Bangladesh can be explored.

Thomas Jones, the child of a craftsman from Wales, was appointed a Methodist clergyman and left with his significant other, Anne, towards India. After their appearance in Calcutta, Anne brought forth a kid, who couldn’t endure and succumbed to death. The Jones’ then, at that point, climbed the slopes up from present-day Bangladesh to arrive at Cherrapunji, where they set up their base in late June 1841. The principal Church Building was based upon a hillock of the present Nongsawlia Cemetery. This structure was obliterated by the extraordinary seismic tremor that happened in June 1897. Therefore the struggles of the early settlers are preserved here. It is one of Meghalaya’s oldest churches

Khoh Ramhah or Maw Trop is a goliath regular stone development. As indicated by legend the column rock is a fossilized cone formed by the bushel of an evil soul. However, the street to reach there isn’t decently molded yet you will experience the beauty in between. Being one of the most visited tourist destinations, this place always leaves its spectators in awe.

Tourists often flock to this destination to spend some leisure time. This place owes its popularity to all the caves located here. The caves do have different entrances to lead you in, and you will also notice two separate river passages within. Isn’t this unique?
